messages:
maria: Heads-up — compliance asked for a console "change tail" view that lets reviewers watch recent tenant policy/route/quota changes in near real-time and grab signed snapshots for evidence.

rahul: Important Q: summary vs full-diff? Full diffs will be huge for some tenants. Maybe default to compact summary + on-demand full diff.

maria: Agreed. Default: one-line semantic summary + actor/display name + short link to full diff. Expandable inline to show full ndiff if needed. Also need a way to flag PII-sensitive fields for redaction.

kim: Ops notes: export jobs need tenant and global quotas. Also require resume tokens for long streams. If we provide a streaming API it must support backfill and tailing with sequence tokens.

sasha: I can mock a UI: compact timeline with "summary / expand / export" actions and a right-hand evidence pane that shows rollout IDs, traces, and the signed bundle status.

maria: What about soft-deletes? If someone deletes a policy we still need the last-known state in the trail so auditors can see what changed before deletion.

rahul: We should persist snapshots when an object is deleted (or archive the last change event). That lets exports reconstruct state timeline.

kim: Implementation constraints: add monotonically increasing sequence_id + ingest checksum for each event. Streaming endpoint returns events as NDJSON with resume_token and watermark.

maria: Example NDJSON line for export (for engineering):

```
{"seq": 12345678, "ts": "2026-02-12T18:02:15Z", "tenant_id": "t-045", "actor": {"id": "u-991","display": "alex"}, "action": "update_policy", "target": "route:billing", "summary": "increase quota 10k->20k", "diff_url": "https://console/redwood/diffs/abcd", "sensitive": ["config.credit_card_masking"], "signed": "s3://.../manifest.sig"}
```

rahul: UX ask: show evidence links inline (rollout id, trace anchor, commit sha). Clicking rollout should open runbook + replay inputs.

maria: Legal: exports must support pseudonymized actor mode (replace display names with stable pseudonyms) and also full-actor mode for staffed audits. So export API needs a mode flag.

audit-bot: Note: retention policy for production tenants is 365 days; trials 90 days. All exported bundles are KMS-encrypted and signed. Audit export creates a manifest with checksum and signature.

kim: Also: quota control for exports — heavy exporters should be charged against exports quota and throttled if they exceed tenant limits. Add a per-tenant concurrent export limit.

sasha: For the console I'll add a small "request export" modal with preview size estimate and a note about pseudonymization and retention.

maria: One more ask: add a tiny breadcrumb in the change detail — "affected routes -> current rollouts" so reviewers don't have to jump around.

rahul: Ok. Action items:
- sasha: mock UI (compact timeline + evidence pane) by EOD Fri
- kim: propose streaming API shape (seq, resume_token, signed_manifest) + quota model
- maria: write compliance requirements doc (pseudonymize modes, retention, signed bundles)
- rahul: UX for inline trace/rollout linking

kim: I'll also add a spike for resume-token semantics and server-side NDJSON chunking.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: — tagging @audit-bot for retention/manifest confirmations :eyes:
